editorial:
Imagine you are out for a perfect day of surfing when things go south fast. You meet a guy who seems okay at first, but he turns out to be a total creep with a scary obsession with sharks. You wake up trapped on his boat, and now you are stuck in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The vibe is super tense because you are stuck in the middle of the ocean with nowhere to run. It feels like a nightmare where the water around you is just as dangerous as the man holding you captive.

The acting is top-notch and makes you really feel for the main character as she tries to outsmart her captor. The pacing stays quick, so you never get bored, though some of the gore might be a bit much for some people. If you love high-stakes thrillers, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to get the best picture, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the surfer manages to trick the killer into a fight on the deck. She uses his own shark-feeding gear against him, trapping him in the ropes. As the sharks swarm the boat, he gets pulled overboard and becomes the meal he wanted so badly. She barely manages to start the engine and sail away just as the boat sinks, leaving the killer to the sharks.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories and scary shark movies.
